info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 以增進學生的聽說技巧為主旨。提供不同教學情境及互動法來營造練習英語環境。將著重會話討論、報告及演講這三大部分來加強學生的口語訓練。會話討論部分：將參與課堂上會話練習及討論多元議題；報告部分：將分組成四到五人一組，進行小組討論及報告小組討論之議題；演講部分：分為即席演講跟非即席演講兩種，並學習分析和評論演講。
description.describe_eh: The main purpose of this class is to help students improve their speaking and listening skills. Many different types of activities will provide students with opportunities to use English in many circumstances. Students will learn to feel confident and comfortable speaking in public in various situations. The course will focus on three areas: discussions, presentations and speeches. Discussions: Students will take part in discussions on various topics. Presentations: Students will team up in groups of four or five to make a presentation to the whole class on an assigned topic and/or a topic of their choice. Speeches: Students will be introduced to the basics of preparing and giving a speech. Each student will deliver at least two speeches (one prepared and one impromptu). The class will also learn to analyze and comment on these speeches.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
a. Absences 
Absences are excused if the student informs the teacher by e-mail, MyFCU system, or in-person BEFORE the missed class. All absence requests must be written in ENGLISH. All other absences will be marked as UNEXCUSED, except in the case of an emergency. Students are responsible for informing their group members of any absence during class practice time, and if they fail to do so, will have points deducted from their attendance grade. It is the student’s responsibility to make up any missed work by contacting the class helper or a classmate. If students are late to class more than 10 minutes, they will have points deducted from their attendance grade. If students are absent for ½ of the class, they will have ½ an absence. If students are never late and have no absences, they will receive extra credit.

b. Participation
Any assignment partially or fully copied from the internet or other sources (ChatGPT, classmates, textbooks, etc.) will receive a zero. If the student is not truthful or forthcoming in this situation, then they may need to complete another assignment in front of the instructor.  All students must participate as equally as possible in group assignments. If any student fails to participate equally in group assignments, their grade will be individualized. If students have any issue with other group members, they should inform the instructor in order to find a solution. 

c. Make-ups
If a student has an EXCUSED absence for any speech day, then they may complete their speech on an alternative class date according to the instructor. If a student has an UNEXCUSED absence for any speech day, then they will receive a zero. There will be no make-up group presentations for unexcused absences. If a student has an excused absence for a group presentation, then the group will perform on a different class date according the instructor. 

d. iLearn 
Students are required to check their iLearn for course materials. 
   
e. Student-Teacher Conferences 
This conference is an informal one-on-one chat with the instructor. Students must prepare questions and discussion topics beforehand for this assignment. Students may discuss any questions related to this course, their future study/work/travel goals, American culture, or hobbies, etc. Students must show their willingness and ability to communicate in English with the instructor. 

f. Extra Credit
Students may complete an extra credit assignment after each speech. Students must e-mail a video performance of their speech with improvements, due two weeks after the speech date. Students will receive plus 10-20 points added to that speech grade, depending on the video quality and improvements shown. Students must confirm with the instructor if they plan to complete any extra credit assignment. 

g. Speech Contest 
Five to seven students will be asked/volunteer to join the Sophomore wide impromptu speech contest, held on _______ from 3pm-5pm at the Fourth International Conference Hall. Students will be competing against Sophomore students from other presentation classes. First prize winner will receive 3,000 NTD, 2nd 2,000 NTD, 3rd 1,500 NTD, and 4th 1,000 NTD. If a student places 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th in the contest, they will receive extra credit points to their lowest speech grade.
